title: StationInfo
description: Station information read via BLE characteristic FFF1 (Read), before the handshake. Unauthenticated and outside the handshake transcript: the app may display it and relies on none of it (profiles/offline/ble-transport.md §3).

stationId.description: The station identifier, unauthenticated: the station's authenticated identity is the certificate of its Challenge (06-security.md §6.5.2).

stationModel.description: Model identifier of the station hardware

firmwareVersion.description: Semantic version of the station firmware

connectivity.description: Current network connectivity status of the station, unauthenticated: the Challenge's stationConnectivity is the one the app acts on.
